definitions.ask: Which emoji should mark rows from the Holidays in United States calendar?
definitions.why: 🇺🇸 passed a live dry run, and only a flag sets holidays apart from personal celebrations.

choices.label: 🇺🇸 names the source calendar; some Linux terminal fonts show it as the letters U S
🎉 renders everywhere but reads as any celebration, close to 🎂 Birthdays
